about: Checked by python/tests/test_example_born2d_reconstruction.py. Lengths in micrometres, spatial frequencies in cycles per micrometre, delta_n in refractive-index units, gaps and residuals relative (L2).

kx_max.why: (NA + NA_illumination) / wavelength, within one frequency bin 1 / (N pixel)

psf_fwhm_x.why: 0.603 / kx_max for a uniformly filled band (sinc), 10 %

psf_aspect.why: missing cone: kx_max / max |Kz| of the coverage, 20 %

model_gap_scaling.why: the Born model error is the next order, so doubling delta_n doubles it

disc_width_x.why: lateral resolution (0.15 µm) is far below the 2 µm diameter, so the half-max width is close to the diameter, 10 %

regression.about: What the example returns today (not the truth): a change here means the operator, the coverage or the reconstruction changed.
